item.title: Abu Dhabi court orders furniture cleaning company to pay Dh10,000 for damaged sofa
item.description: The Abu Dhabi Commercial Court has ordered a furniture cleaning company to pay Dh10,000 in compensation to a woman after it failed to remove a stain from her sofa and instead damaged the upholstery by using inappropriate cleaning materials.
